subject: update snowball compilation check to see if lto_supported (#887)
reason: The change only modifies third_party/snowball/CMakeLists.txt to gate LTO behind a check_ipo_supported probe (replacing an unconditional -flto with INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION plus -fno-fat-lto-objects when supported) while keeping -O3 and -w. It is a build/CI compilation-flags change with no behaviour change: no command, reply, indexing, replication or persistence path differs between the builds, so a compared sequence would find no marked difference and no fault scenario can reach it. No scenario is needed.
